name: Hearth
description: A cozy shared space for two people on two PCs. Pair once with a code, then add copies of this widget as an Overview strip, a drawing Board or a Pet. Needs the Umbra relay, which stores your names, dates, drawings and pet state (deleted 7 days after unpairing or after 30 days unused) and never your location.
author: Yacine-DH
changelog: A preview picture for Browse, the rounded Nunito font, and an Overview strip that fits its default size: the Tap button moved up beside the name, so nothing overlaps or gets cut off.

view.label: View
view.hint: Add more copies of Hearth in My widgets and give each its own view. All copies share one pairing.
